set.body: Parent epic: bd-01KR8ZJJ8W882F1S9JWE06K741. Add plot_resolution_curve(), plot_scale_space_map(), and energy_mass_map(). Resolution curve should show global, Gaussian scales, and voxelwise/identity endpoint. Energy-mass maps should use above-null excess or positive studentized energy, not raw z^2. Tests: returned plot/data structures and no failure on no-hit results.
set.title: Scale-space: resolution curve and map plotting
